question: 这段观测能不能用来做 1–12 Hz 的 P/S 拾取？

finish_audit.note: 本审计只读取本轮实际状态；它不补做检查、不发请求、不调用模型，也不会把缺失的完成标志补成成功。

next_action.why: 1 station(s) carry measurable band data, so the asked band question is answerable for the reviewed set (stations not acquired remain unknown)

limitations: No new acquisition was permitted this round, so the scope stayed at the single already-acquired station CHIMA (cf3bfe63e905); no network-wide conclusion is possible.

Stability was run on this round's declared grid [[3,12]] Hz and returned stability=insufficient_configurations: only 1 of 13 grid configurations produced a pick (4 Z STA/LTA configs gave no pick), so the automatic onset at ~2.53 s is not reproducible and cannot be treated as confirmed.
The 1-8 Hz onset check for CHIMA returned no pick time (onset_utc=null) with no channel-integrity flags; a null onset is not proof that no arrival exists.

Band support for 1-12 Hz is satisfied (100 Hz sampling, Nyquist 50 Hz, 3 aligned components Z/N/E), so this answer does not rule out usability on band grounds alone; it says the pick behaviour is undetermined from the stored data.
The requested 1-12 Hz band was not rewritten by the 3-12 Hz diagnostic grid change; the quizzed band remains 1-12 Hz, and the wider requested band was not independently tested.
